scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-library.ts && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/primitives build && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/icons build && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/themes build && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/website build
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/website check:export && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/website check:snippets && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/website check:examples && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/website check:sandboxes && pnpm test
scripts.test: node --test tests/bootstrap.test.ts && pnpm --filter @radix-solid/website test && playwright test
